services.desc: Lees Ferry requires that you bring the following items, most of which can be purchased at our fly shop: To the fly-fisher more accustomed to a traditional meadow or mountain stream, the Colorado River is often initially intimidating. However, in reality, it is much like a giant limestone river or spring creek with diverse fishing opportunities. The gravel bars, backwaters, eddies and main river channel offer opportunities to fish dries, nymphs and streamers within a few hundred yards. Stalk rainbow trout in water only a few inches deep or cast size #18 or #20 midge or pupae patterns to trout feeding in deep, dark runs. blurb: Lees Ferry Anglers is Arizona’s largest fly fishing outfitter and oldest fly shop located at the crown of the Grand Canyon. They offer guided fly fishing trips, kayak rentals and backhaul services, lodging, and dining. The location is near many attractions including hiking, rafting, fishing, and national parks.
